notes.title: Yuri Dating Agency Celebrates 1st Anniversary with 50% Off Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206626/168c9637eb2e4c0d175abe3f9b6db355b00e5a96.png[/img]

Greetings, 

It's been an incredible year since the launch of "Yuri Dating Agency," and we're thrilled to announce that our beloved visual novel has sold over 1,800 copies! To commemorate this milestone and express our heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated community, we're hosting a special 50% OFF sale from June 22nd 12:00(GMT+8) to June 23rd 12:00(GMT+8).

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and future projects from our dedicated team. We can't wait to embark on new adventures with you! The team is currently developing a new game called "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861290/_/][b][u]Distant Oceanic Getaway.[/u][/b][/url]" Please add it to your wish list, as the demo will be out soon. Stay tuned for more updates or follow us on Twitter for the latest news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206626/a52cb65a56a074125bf6f3440652cae9076d3264.png[/img]

Happy Anniversary!

Love,
Sine @ Red bean Taiyaki Studios

notes.title: Thank you for 1300 download!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206626/e107bacc39222a8f7601539d426eb86a9ee73676.png[/img]

Dear All,

This game has reached an incredible milestone, surpassing 1300 downloads on Steam. I am overjoyed and wishes to express my deepest gratitude to the dedicated players and supporters who have made this achievement possible.

We are thrilled to announce that a brand new game is currently in development with improved graphics and an even more immersive game play experience.

notes.title: Improving Translation and Dialogue
notes.content:
Dear Players,

It has come to our attention that the translation in the game needs improvement, which has been affecting your overall gameplay. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and assure you that we are taking immediate action to fix this.

I am diligently working on fixing all the translations of the choices in the game now. I want to ensure that every dialogue is accurately translated, allowing you to fully immerse yourselves in the captivating storyline. 

The first round of fix will be rolled out within this week, addressing most of the translations bugs, re-translating all the choices and fixing all the bugs that would break the game.

Additionally, we are committed to providing a comprehensive update in Aug. This update will encompass a thorough review and refinement of the game's dialogue, ensuring a smooth and engaging narrative experience for all players.

We sincerely appreciate your patience and support during this process. We value your feedback tremendously and aim to deliver a high-quality gaming experience that meets your expectations. Stay tuned for the upcoming updates.

notes.title: Yuri Dating Agency - A New WLW Romantic Adventure Awaits!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206626/9226eacefeb8ce9639ca8564ef4249eb006d2c09.png[/img]

Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that "Yuri Dating Agency" will be launching on 23/6/23! Get ready for a brand-new romantic adventure that will immerse you in a brand new world, filled with love and emotions. 
This is a speed dating simulator for WLW. You're a girl who likes girls, walking into this Yuri dating agency to find yourself a date. Here, you will be able to get to know lots of girls. Will you be able to win their hearts?

Add this game to your Wishlist to be among the first to experience the sweetness and challenges of love! Come and join the romantic adventure of "Yuri Dating Agency" as we explore the wonderful world of love together!
